nom: r.e.m. beauty Full Night's Sleep Cooling Blurring Undereye Balm

avis.texte: * My absolute favorite new item for my skin care routine! SO COOL! It feels incredibly refreshing the moment I apply it, and the cooling sensation instantly helps wake up my eyes, especially in the mornings. The balm glides on smoothly without feeling greasy or sticky, and it absorbs nicely into the skin. With regular use, I've noticed my under-eye area looks more hydrated, smoother, and less puffy. It layers well under makeup without causing creasing or pilling, making it perfect for my daily routine. The packaging is convenient and easy to use, so I can take it with me wherever I go. Overall, this is a fantastic product that leaves my under-eye area feeling refreshed and looking healthier. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a quick, cooling boost for tired eyes *
